<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">

      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-opacity="0.15"/>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Small arrow marker for entry points -->
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="4" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L0,8 L8,4 z" fill="#646565"/>

  <!-- Arrows with tail starting on circle, tangential direction, clockwise -->

  <!-- Moved 5px down, rotated 15° counter-clockwise total -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 750" width="1000" height="750">

  <!-- 
    Pyramid geometry - 25% proportionally larger:
    Original: 800x600, pyramid base 400px, height 305px
    New: 1000x750, pyramid base 500px, height 381px (all × 1.25)
    
    - Apex: (500, 188) - was (400, 150)
    - Base: from (250, 569) to (750, 569) - 500px wide (was 400px)
    - Total height: 381px (was 305px)
    - Heights (all × 1.25): 
      - Level 1: 150px (was 120px)
      - Level 2: 116px (was 92.5px)
      - Level 3: 103px (was 82.5px)
    - Level boundaries: y=338 (was 270), y=459 (was 367.5), y=569 (was 455)
    - 6px gaps between levels (was 5px)
    - Same slope ratio maintained: 250/381 = 0.656

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">
  <!-- Enhanced Hub & Spoke Template with 6 Nodes -->
  <defs>
    <!-- Gradients for richer visual appearance -->
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    <!-- Enhanced shadow filter -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
      <feOffset dx="0" dy="3" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.2"/>
      <feComposite in2="offsetblur" operator="in"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Glow effect for hub -->
    <filter id="hub_glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="coloredBlur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Smaller arrow markers (40% of original size) -->
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="4" markerHeight="4" refX="3.2" refY="1.2" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
      <path d="M0,0 L0,2.4 L3.6,1.2 z" fill="#7d7e7f"/>

  <!--
